_why: storyboard round 4 (toki 2026-10-26: 'drops dichter schneiden wie die profis (ca. 0,5 s), riser / hi-hat / farbwechsel rein'): script v3b (hold + flash on the beat, measured hi-hat phase, riser / roll / final-build tables) pictured as moments; references looked at by eye; round 3 references kept where they matched.

moments.line: cold open / the last picture first (shot 0b) - she blinded by the light, a black shape
moments.camera: on the beam axis at the lamp, h 13.7 d 6 fov 58
moments.her: THE silhouette: hangs her whole weight on the brass of the lamp (pull-heavy-object 1.9)
moments.fx: white-gold fills the frame, she a black shape - 6 frames
moments.light: the beam is the only light
moments.rule: flood_silhouette: 38-66 % of the frame near white, the figure the only dark mass, small (5-12 %), even room - loneliness + awe, nowhere else to look (YOASOBI Idol 186, Frieren 69)

moments.line: frame 0.5: her eye opens under the black surface (shot 1)
moments.camera: from below her cheek, h 0.35 d 0.75 fov 50, pull-back arc
moments.her: eye snaps open, glides up the lighthouse cable
moments.fx: the beam sweeps the surface above like a blade (30 % width), a pulse sparks up the cable
moments.light: black-navy, her violet dots, the white beam far above
moments.rule: pros open low key (49 % of pro shots are low key, 12 % high key): darkness is the ground, the first light is the event

moments.line: hit 1: the pulse blows up the cable (shot 5)
moments.camera: low converging-cable frame, h 0.4 d 1.2 fov 60, roll -8, crash in
moments.her: LUNGES up the cable at the light (roar 1.0), mouth open
moments.fx: cable white-hot, two-tone 2 frames, shake 5; then drop 1 as hold + flash: an anchor held 2 beats, a 4-frame flash insert per bar (a simple shape in black), a picture every 0.47 s on average
moments.light: the pulse is the key light
moments.rule: two_tone_hit on the hit; drop flashes: pro shots under 0.25 s are the simplest and emptiest (Edgerunners 6.25: one small light, 96 % empty) - a 4-frame picture must read at once

moments.line: hi-hat roll: the picture stutters on every measured 16th (row 15)
moments.camera: 11 cuts on the measured onsets 27.771-28.932 (3-4 frames each): her chest-open ping <-> the ping ring, d 1.1
moments.her: PINGS: yelling 1.0, chest open, arms wide; sings
moments.fx: the stutter frames are the SAME light (X2: no strobe), the last one lands on the downbeat
moments.light: the ping ring lights both pictures
moments.rule: pros cut 0.17 s micro-flashes on drum / hi-hat rolls before a release (Edgerunners 6-7, Calli 6.5, CSM ED1, aespa) - the eye counts the hits it hears

moments.line: verse 1: she CLAWS at the passing beam (shot 19)
moments.camera: close, the lens on the beam path, d 0.9 (r3: was 1.2 - her claws must reach the glass), push with the vocal rise
moments.her: claws thrown at the light as it passes the lens: her hands hit the glass at the frame edges, face centred between them (roar 1.0 held 5 frames), sings
moments.fx: ink slash 1 on the melody peak, the beam's edge flickers
moments.light: the beam crossing, two-tone flash on the lens crossing; film grain, broken ink edges
moments.rule: lens_attack: hands flat on the lens at the frame edges, the face centred between them; drawn marks over the face (Arcane) - the fourth wall breaks, the viewer is inside and threatened

moments.line: riser 1 into the stop: one push through the cuts to her eyes (rows 26-27)
moments.camera: ONE axis below her face looking up at the beam: d 3.0 -> 2.2 -> 1.6 -> 1.2 -> 0.9 -> 0.7, then half beats 0.55 -> 0.45 -> 0.38 -> 0.32 (her eyes ECU) on the measured beats 58.70-61.97
moments.her: floats looking up, then treading water, eyes up, hair floating; sings
moments.fx: the grade climbs toward white with the measured brightness (+404 Hz/s), then the stop 62.167: the light falls away, one drop hangs
moments.light: the beam on her face from above, whiter with every cut
moments.rule: pros step-zoom into the eyes right before a transition (Arcane Enemy 126 / 157 / 178, why pass) and hold near black in the silence (Ado SHOW 124): the build is felt as an approach, the stop lands as the cliff

moments.line: the war cry after the stop (shot 28)
moments.camera: ECU, h at her mouth d 0.62 fov 48, roll +6, 3-frame push
moments.her: screams INTO the lens, claws at us (roar 1.0), mouth wide open
moments.fx: ring bursts past the glass, ink detonation with a hole at her face, chroma 3, shake 5; the ink line climbs with her measured notes (red heads 62.75-64.45)
moments.light: two-tone paper / ink + her violet + one red
moments.rule: ecu_scream: the open mouth fills 30-60 % of the frame, wide lens close, tilted, cut by the edges, one hue + black - the blow, no room to look away

moments.line: chorus 1: a new picture on EVERY bar, a slash per bar (shots 29-35)
moments.camera: per bar: the row camera held 2 beats -> punch-in on beat 3 -> a 4-frame flash insert on the hi-hat (the and of 4) -> reverse; the template breaks: row 31 holds 3 beats, row 33 holds the claw 2 beats, row 34 flashes after beat 2, row 35 double time into the hold
moments.her: lunge, sing into the lens, hook-punch, back kick, claw, arms wide, sing - one action per bar
moments.fx: ink slash per bar, barb flick, lamp flash on bar 7; then bar 9 HOLDS still against the loud track
moments.light: two-tone ink / paper, her violet, grain
moments.rule: hold + flash, not a metronome (why pass, 13 pro videos): anchors on the action, micro-flashes on the hats (measured: 0.20 s after each beat) - chorus 1 a picture every 0.57 s, JJK 47-49 shows the burst

moments.line: colour flip on the turn to the minor chord (Bm, measured)
moments.camera: a cut ON 67.600 to her eyes inside the ink crown, d 0.35 (row 30 punch-in) - then row 31 holds the hook-punch 3 beats
moments.her: eyes wide inside the black splash, singing at us
moments.fx: for one beat the picture turns gold-orange on ink, then back to violet two-tone
moments.light: the only warm moment of chorus 1
moments.rule: pros flip colour worlds on musical turns (Ado Usseewa blue -> red, Edgerunners warm / cold on adjacent cuts); the complementary accent is 14 % of pro shots, so it hits - 4 times on the measured minor turn (weltschmerz) + every hit flash before 154 in gold-orange two-tone; never after 154

moments.camera: crane straight up from 0.6 to 6 m in 1.2 s
moments.her: arms raised, head back, mouth open on the held B5
moments.fx: a violet-white pillar of her light, exactly as long as the note
moments.light: her pillar the only light in the storm
moments.rule: light_pillar: one vertical column of light, centred, 62-88 % dark, the figure < 9 % at its base - scale, an event from above; its length reads as time (as long as the note)

moments.camera: close on her, the black cloud edge sweeps across the lens first
moments.her: pings at the rock (casting-spell 1.0), mouth open
moments.fx: the ping hits the rock and SHATTERS into 12 two-tone shards flying at the lens, stutter on twos, shake 4
moments.rule: two_tone_hit as shards: the frame breaks into white pieces with black between, the figure a cut-out; stutter on twos = the eye counts the hits

moments.line: the sky clears: the one moon (shot 48)
moments.camera: wide from behind her, h 1.2 d 5
moments.her: stands in the surf, looking up
moments.fx: clouds part in 30 frames, the moon 45 % of the frame over the lighthouse
moments.light: moonlight rims her; the beauty that mocks her (her rain call wrong again)
moments.rule: a calm moment in pros = a long hold: shots over 2 s move least (0.03 frame widths/s vs 0.105 under 0.25 s, 5,999 pro shots), a big calm mass (the moon) and a small figure - the only place the film breathes

moments.line: riser 2 -> the cliff -> the hidden stop (rows 52-53H)
moments.camera: 118.70 / 119.17 / 119.40 three cuts closer on her "not crying" glare (d 0.7 -> 0.55 -> 0.42), the glare held; 119.867 black; 120.37 the slow-motion leap (no cuts); 121.90 freeze at the apex
moments.her: FREEZE at the apex of the leap, the rain drops hang in the air
moments.fx: the riser goes on as LIGHT after the black: the rain halo brightens 20 % -> 90 % with the measured brightness (+854 Hz/s); then the lamp dark, drops hang
moments.light: near black, her dots the only light
moments.rule: stop -> drop as the pros do it (Ado SHOW 124-127): build, near-black with one small light, then a flash on the hit and HOLD the payoff - the cuts end before the slow motion, the light carries the rest

moments.camera: low on the ledge, d 2.8, roll -10
moments.her: SUPERHERO LANDING on the rock (swing-backflip-to-superhero-pose 1.9), rain halo
moments.fx: lamp flash two-tone, shake 5, a ring of rain, ink slash
moments.rule: the landing is the ANCHOR (held 1.7 s, the payoff after the stop), the measured hit 123.809 slams in a 4-frame two-tone flash; then drop 2 as hold + flash, a picture every 0.61 s

moments.line: false win: the beam passes the lens (shot 66)
moments.camera: on the lens-side beam axis, medium d 3
moments.fx: the beam swings and PASSES the lens in 10 frames, flash, shake 4
moments.rule: beam_at_lens: the source swings into the lens, the centre flares to white with rays + dust, the figure lost in it - blinding = an invisible cut, the next shot can be anything

moments.line: the lamp room: she SCREAMS with the effort (shot 70)
moments.her: screams, arms wide on the brass (yelling 1.9), mouth wide open
moments.fx: ink slash, the lens rings flash past
moments.rule: ecu_scream (second one): same rule, other side and colour than 62.6 so it does not repeat - the effort scream, eyes shut

moments.line: the final build: four pulls, every cut closer on the beam axis (rows 79-82)
moments.camera: one axis: d 5.0 -> 4.2 -> 3.8 -> 3.5 -> 3.0 -> 2.7 -> 2.4 -> 2.0 -> 1.8 -> 1.7 -> 1.5 -> 1.4 -> 1.3 -> 1.2 -> 0.9; cuts thicken with the measured hi-hat density: every 2 beats, every beat, half beats
moments.her: pulls the lamp with everything: four pulls, foot braced, whole back, face strained, eyes on us
moments.fx: the beam passes closer each time: 16 m, 8 m, 3.5 m, 1 m - 4 white flashes in 4.5 s (X2), the grade climbs toward white from 173.24
moments.rule: pros accelerate the cut rate into the climax (bp-hylt pre-chorus, why pass) and keep the hits on the cuts (172.524 / 174.428 / 176.286 measured)

moments.line: THE LAST HIT (A+): the dip to black, the lamp in her pupils, then the silhouette in the flood (rows 82-83)
moments.camera: the cold-open camera: on the beam axis, h 13.7 d 6 fov 58
moments.her: THE silhouette (same as 0.2 s): her whole weight on the lamp
moments.fx: 176.90 the dip: near black, only her dots; 177.167 two frames: the lamp turning into her pupils (ECU); 177.238 hard cut on the flash to the silhouette: white-gold 100 % 3 frames, chroma, shake 5, held
moments.rule: pre-drop blackout (Ado SHOW 173) + the eye ECU reflecting the light (Edgerunners 27, eye reflections) + flood_silhouette held: the blow is the dark -> eye -> white sequence, the silhouette is the payoff held - recommendation A+, toki decides

moments.line: the ink night: her dots become stars (shot 86)
moments.camera: close on her face, slow breathing push
moments.her: looks at us from the lamp, mouth closed
moments.fx: the sky inked over, 60-90 drawn stars burst from her dots on the biggest transient of the song
moments.light: ink black, violet stars, the gold beam
moments.rule: star_sky: ink black + many small white points of varied size + 1-2 cross flares + a strong diagonal (the beam); her open eye catches the stars (Oshi no Ko 38) - quiet vastness after the noise
